explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/234: for each c ≥ 0, the density f(c) of {n : (p_{n+1} - p_n)/log n < c} exists, and f is continuous. The index is 0-based via primeGap. The shift by one in n and log n is asymptotically negligible and does not affect the existence or continuity of the limiting distribution. The open question is stated affirmatively.
